notes.title: RBNX Release and Launch Week Discounts!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, We did it! Ropu Barastu No X version 1.0 is now available on steam. To celebrate we're discounting all our games for launch week, so check them out!

As always your feedback is greatly appreciated. Please contact us via discord ( https://discord.gg/umgURVp2tS ) or the steam community page and let us know what you think!
